items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And the trombones was Henry Coker -- and Benny Powell and myself.

ctx.x: And we had Albert Aarons. He came in in Joe Newman's place. He stayed in California. What a beautiful trumpet player he is, too. A very nice guy. All of them were nice fellows, every one of them, in that band. And the trombones was Henry Coker --
Oh, yeah, we can't forget him.
